name: VetraApp
description: A Vetra App: what a publisher owns, the repository it deploys from, and what it has published.

global.initialValue:
{
  "name": null,
  "slug": null,
  "owner": null,
  "status": "PENDING_IDENTITY",
  "repository": null,
  "identity": null,
  "productionEnvironmentId": null,
  "previews": null,
  "artifacts": [],
  "templates": [],
  "terms": []
}

operations.name: SET_APP_DETAILS
operations.description: Set the app's name, slug and owner.

operations.name: CONNECT_REPOSITORY
operations.description: Record the GitHub repository this app deploys from.

operations.name: SET_IDENTITY
operations.description: Record the app's Renown workload identity and its expiry.

operations.name: SET_STATUS
operations.description: Set the app's lifecycle status. DELETED is a soft delete and is kept forever.

operations.name: SET_PREVIEWS
SET_PRODUCTION_ENVIRONMENT
operations.description: Point the app at its production environment document.

operations.name: RECORD_ARTIFACT_VERSION
operations.description: Record a published version of one of this app's artifacts.
operations.schema:
input RecordArtifactVersionInput {
  kind: VetraAppArtifactKind!
  name: String!
  version: String!
  reference: String!
  commitSha: String
  runId: String
  publishedAt: DateTime!
}

operations.name: SET_ARTIFACT_CHANNEL
operations.description: Point a channel at a published version.

errors.name: UnknownArtifactError
errors.description: No such artifact on this app.

errors.name: UnknownArtifactVersionError
errors.description: A channel may only point at a published version.

modules.name: licensing
modules.description: Environment templates and the licence terms an app hands out.

operations.name: ADD_TEMPLATE

errors.name: DuplicateTemplateError
errors.description: A template with this id exists.

operations.name: SET_TEMPLATE_DETAILS
operations.description: Update a template; absent fields are unchanged.
operations.schema:
input SetTemplateDetailsInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String
  mode: TemplateInstanceMode
  sharedEnvironment: PHID
  size: String
  baseDomain: String
  packageRegistry: URL
}

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: SharedTemplateServicesError
errors.description: A SHARED template carries no services or packages.

operations.name: ADD_TEMPLATE_SERVICE
operations.description: Add a service to a DEDICATED template.
operations.schema:
input AddTemplateServiceInput {
  templateId: OID!
  id: OID!
  type: TemplateServiceType!
  prefix: String
  artifactName: String
  artifactChannel: AutoUpdateChannel
}

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: SharedTemplateServicesError
errors.description: A SHARED template carries no services or packages.

errors.name: DuplicateServiceError
errors.description: A service with this id exists on the template.

errors.name: ArtifactOnNonFusionServiceError
errors.description: Only a FUSION service can reference an artifact.

operations.name: REMOVE_TEMPLATE_SERVICE
operations.description: Remove a service from a template.

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: UnknownServiceError
errors.description: No such service on the template.

operations.name: ADD_TEMPLATE_PACKAGE
operations.description: Add a package to a DEDICATED template.

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: SharedTemplateServicesError
errors.description: A SHARED template carries no services or packages.

errors.name: DuplicatePackageError
errors.description: A package with this id exists on the template.

operations.name: REMOVE_TEMPLATE_PACKAGE
operations.description: Remove a package from a template.

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: UnknownPackageError
errors.description: No such package on the template.

operations.name: DELETE_TEMPLATE

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: TemplateInUseError
errors.description: A term still references this template.

operations.name: ADD_TERM
operations.description: Add a licence term in DRAFT.
operations.schema:
input AddTermInput {
  id: OID!
  kind: String!
  label: String
  templateId: OID
  validityDays: Int
  issuers: [LicenseIssuerKind!]
}

errors.name: DuplicateTermError
errors.description: A term with this id exists.

errors.name: InvalidKindError
errors.description: A kind must be non-blank without surrounding spaces.

errors.name: DuplicateKindError
errors.description: Another term of this app already uses this kind.

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: NegativeValidityError
errors.description: validityDays must be positive.

operations.name: SET_TERM_DETAILS
operations.description: Update a term; absent fields are unchanged.
operations.schema:
input SetTermDetailsInput {
  id: OID!
  kind: String
  label: String
  templateId: OID
  validityDays: Int
  issuers: [LicenseIssuerKind!]
}

errors.name: TermNotFoundError
errors.description: No such term.

errors.name: InvalidKindError
errors.description: A kind must be non-blank without surrounding spaces.

errors.name: KindImmutableError
errors.description: The kind of a published term is fixed.

errors.name: DuplicateKindError
errors.description: Another term of this app already uses this kind.

errors.name: TemplateNotFoundError
errors.description: No such template.

errors.name: NegativeValidityError
errors.description: validityDays must be positive.

errors.name: TermIncompleteError
errors.description: An ACTIVE term needs a template and at least one issuer.

operations.name: PUBLISH_TERM

errors.name: TermNotFoundError
errors.description: No such term.

errors.name: TermIncompleteError
errors.description: A term needs a template and at least one issuer to be published.

operations.name: RETIRE_TERM

errors.name: TermNotFoundError
errors.description: No such term.

errors.name: TermNotPublishedError
errors.description: Only an ACTIVE term can be retired.
